<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at ca29960f5cec21270ccd6b964ca02f0d2f33c899 -->

## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features ✨
* feat(query): support create iceberg table with partition and properties by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17812
* feat(query): support alter table/database refresh cache by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17841
* feat(query): variant support extension types(Decimal, Binary, Date, Timestamp, Interval) by @b41sh in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17835
* feat: Add sampled trace support by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17850
* feat: unload preserve order if the source is ordered. by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17864
* feat(optimizer): part support decorrelating correlated subqueries in join conditions by @forsaken628 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17871
* feat(cluster): support fuzzy match for warehouse unassign node by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17877
* feat(meta-client-semaphore): generate semaphore sequence using timestamps to reduce conflicts by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17878
* feat(query): atomic workload group metadata management by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17880
* feat(query): support manage query workload through sql by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17881
* feat(query): iceberg data cache by @sundy-li in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17787
* feat: impl `NgramIndex` for `FuseTable`, improve like query performance by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17852
* chore: `VirtualColumn` Bind by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17862
* feat: support using fragment forest to execute additional broadcast operations. by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17872
* feat: new table option `enable_auto_vacuum` by @dantengsky in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17884
* feat: new settings `data_retention_num_snapshots_to_keep` by @dantengsky in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17893
* feat(meta-service): add initialization complete flag for watch by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17900
* fix: avoid excessive concurrency in row fetch by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17885
* feat(query): Support `fuse_virtual_column` function to show virtual column size by @b41sh in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17910
* feat(base): allow exceeded  memory limit if no workload by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17785
* feat: Re-introduce Streaming Load API by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17921
* feat(query): support unset quota for workload group by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17924
* feat: Supports reading table data from Iceberg ORC by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17898
* feat(parse): Simplify the matching pattern when parse function, avoid exponential backtracking by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17942
* feat(meta-client): add `watch_with_initialization()` method by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17944
* feat: support async function for merge not match clause by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17941
* feat(query): UserOption add workload_group by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17913
* feat(query): Independent system/information_schema database in different catalogs by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17863
* feat: support select from AVRO files. by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17953
* feat(query): support show

detail.readme:
Databend

Enterprise Data Warehouse for AI Agents

one warehouse for all your data

SQL analytics, vector search, and full-text search in a single Rust warehouse on object storage: fast, elastic, and grows with your data — with sandboxed Python UDFs for agents.

☁️ Try Cloud • 🚀 Quick Start • 📈 Performance • 📖 Documentation


## 💡 Why Databend? Databend is an open-source data warehouse built in Rust. Analytics, search, and agent workloads run on the same tables, so there is no second system to sync. | | | | :--- | :--- | | **📊 One Warehouse**
SQL analytics, vector search, full-text search, auto schema evolution, transactions. | **🤖 Agent-Ready**
Sandboxed Python UDFs for agent logic, SQL for orchestration. | | **🏢 Enterprise Scale**
Fast vectorized engine, elastic compute on object storage: S3, Azure, GCS. | **🌿 Branching**
Git-like data versioning. Agents experiment safely on production snapshots. | ![Databend Architecture](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/288dea8d-0243-4c45-8d18-d4d402b08075) ## 📈 Performance Published results on Databend Cloud with default settings. Each page includes the SQL to reproduce it. | Benchmark | Result | | :--- | :--- | | [TPC-H SF100 vs. Snowflake](https://docs.databend.com/guides/benchmark/tpch) | 1.25× faster, ~60% lower cost | | [Data ingestion vs. Snowflake](https://docs.databend.com/guides/benchmark/data-ingest) | 5.15× faster, 91% lower cost | | [Vector & full-text search](https://docs.databend.com/guides/benchmark/search-vector) | 10M docs: vector p50 41 ms, full-text p50 35 ms | | [TPC-H SF1000 (1 TB) scaling](https://docs.databend.com/guides/benchmark/tpch-sf1000) | 4.1× faster on Large vs. Small warehouse | See all [benchmarks](https://docs.databend.com/guides/benchmark). ## ⚡ Quick Start **Cloud (Recommended)** — [Sign up](https://app.databend.com/), create a warehouse, and run SQL in the worksheet. [Cloud guide →](https://docs.databend.com/guides/cloud/) **Self-hosted** — Run the all-in-one image and connect with [BendSQL](https://docs.databend.com/guides/connect/sql-clients/bendsql): ```bash docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 datafuselabs/databend bendsql -u root ``` See [Docker image options](docker/README.md) and [self-hosted deployment](https://docs.databend.com/guides/self-hosted) for credentials, storage, and production setup. ### Your First Query Analytics, full-text search, and vector search in one table: ```sql CREATE TABLE docs ( id INT, content STRING, embedding VECTOR(3), INVERTED INDEX content_idx(content), VECTOR INDEX embedding_idx(embedding) distance = 'cosine' ); INSERT INTO docs VALUES (1, 'SQL analytics for agents', [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), (2, 'Vector search for documents', [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]); SELECT id, content FROM docs WHERE MATCH(content, 'analytics'); SELECT id, content FROM docs ORDER BY COSINE_DISTANCE(embedding, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]::VECTOR(3)) LIMIT 1; ``` Both queries return document `1`. Learn more: [Vector search](https://docs.databend.com/guides/query/vector-db) · [JSON & search](https://docs.databend.com/guides/query/json-search). ## 🤖 Agent-Ready Architecture Databend's **Sandbox UDF** enables flexible agent orchestration with a three-layer architecture: - **Control Plane**: Resource scheduling, permission validation, sandbox lifecycle management - **Execution Plane** (Databend): SQL orchestration, issues requests via Arrow Flight - **Compute Plane** (Sandbox Workers): Isolated sandboxes running your agent logic ```sql -- Define your agent logic CREATE FUNCTION my_agent(input STRING) RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE python HANDLER = 'run' AS $$ def run(input): # Your agent logic: LLM calls, tool use, reasoning... answer = f"processed: {input}" return answer $$; -- Orchestrate agents with SQL SELECT my_agent(question) FROM tasks; ``` ## 🚀 Use Cases - **AI Agents**: Sandbox UDF + SQL orchestration + branching for safe operations - **Analytics & BI**: Large-scale SQL analytics — [Learn more](https://docs.databend.com/guides/query/sql-analytics) - **Search & RAG**: Vector + full-text search — [Learn more](https://docs.databend.com/guides/query/vector-db) ## 🤝 Community & Support - [📖 Documentation](https://docs.databend.com/) - [💬 Join Slack](https://link.databend.com/join-slack) - [🐛 Issue Tracker](https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/issues) - [🗺️ Roadmap](https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/issues/14167) - [🛠️ Contributing](AI_POLICY.md) — AI-assisted PRs are welcome; a responsible human must review the full diff **Contributors are immortalized in the `system.contributors` table 🏆** ## 📄 License Databend is licensed under [Apache 2.0](LICENSE). A small set of enterprise features is under [Elastic 2.0](licenses/Elastic.txt), see [LICENSING.md](LICENSING.md) | [Licensing FAQ](https://docs.databend.com/guides/products/dee/license) ---
